data.name: Haroun
data.long_meaning: Haroun is the name of Prophet Harun (Aaron) in Islamic tradition. He was a brother and advisor to Prophet Musa (Moses) and was appointed as his successor during his absence. This name is filled with spiritual significance and is a reminder of the importance of brotherhood, obedience, and leadership in Islam.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of brotherhood and obedience in Islam.
